_comment: Routing and scoring rules used by the LLM transcript analyser. All threshold values here are injected into the system prompt at runtime — changing them changes the LLM's routing behaviour without any code change or redeploy.

teamRouting._note: salesMinScore: interest_score at or above this value → owning_team='sales'. marketingMaxScore: score at or below this value → owning_team='marketing'. If a score falls between the two (should not happen with integer 1-10 scale), default to 'marketing'.
